# book_booking (Resource)

The booking records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `auto_resolve_conflicts` (Boolean) Trim schedule entries that fall outside the bookable timeslots instead of returning 409
- `canceled_at` (String)
- `cancellation` (Dynamic) Schedule entries describing windows where the booking is canceled
- `capability` (Dynamic) Input per capability id, valid against the input schema of that capability. Required for each capability on the bookable or its types whose input schema has required fields
- `checkin_id` (String) The key of the checkin record.
- `description` (String) Booking description
- `hold_expires_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Booking name
- `owner_id` (String)
- `reserved_at` (String)
- `schedule` (Dynamic) Schedule entries describing when the booking is active
- `status` (String)
- `style` (Dynamic) Booking style overrides
